status: prereg only; no solve starts until the user confirms

V_0.note: A4c Vext tables (232 / 218 boards, values solved at the frozen P14 ranges)

R_0.note: Gext terminal ranges differ from P14 (node6 e143cd2e0fcaa9d7 -> 27af42e0c3607d56): the outer loop starts by solving the panel at R_0

solver.postflop: 1000 iterations cap, target 0.300% pot, check every 25
solver.preflop: t2_cont_terminal, cfg_4h_mr4_30bb.json, 400 iterations, PREFLOP_EQ_SEED=202, PREFLOP_MULTIWAY_SEED=202, PREFLOP_EQ_SAMPLES=1200 (as A4c)
solver.policy: a board that does not reach <= 0.300% pot at the 1000-iteration cap pauses its step for a user decision (the A4c Kc9h9d exception covers only that A4c artifact hash); other boards keep solving

estimator: A4c estimator unchanged (stratified mean, RHO, aggregate.py operation order)

step_k.1_postflop: solve all 450 panel boards at R_k (terminal exports of the current preflop state) -> per-board values
step_k.2_V_raw: V_raw,k = panel estimate from step-k values (undamped)
step_k.3_raw_solve: separate preflop solve g(V_raw,k) -> sigma_raw,k, R_raw,k (used only for measurement)
step_k.4_raw_residual: Delta_raw,k = metrics of the current state sigma_k measured in the raw game G_raw,k (raw state vs current state)
step_k.5_U_k: panel uncertainty of step k: the A4c joint draw manifest (seed 20261005, 60 draws, sha256 b70b1d5e...) re-applied to step-k board values, FPC as A4c; per replicate r: table V_raw,k^(r) -> preflop solve -> metric of sigma_r in G_raw,k; U_k = mean over r. No extra flop solve.
step_k.6_damped_next: V_{k+1} = 0.5 * V_k + 0.5 * V_raw,k (element-wise on the terminal value tables only) -> preflop solve g(V_{k+1}) -> sigma_{k+1}, R_{k+1}; strategies and ranges are never mixed directly
step_k.k_range: k = 0, 1, 2 (at most 3 postflop panels); after k = 2 the damped state x_3 is produced but not evaluated (labelled so)

metrics.primary_seat: whole-seat swap dEV_p = EV_p(sigma_raw,k; G_raw,k) - EV_p(sigma_k,p (+) sigma_raw,k,-p; G_raw,k) for BTN, SB, BB (CO reported)
metrics.primary_node: class-regret excess of sigma_k at BTN first-in, BB vs BTN, SB first-in, BB vs SB in G_raw,k over sigma_raw,k own residual
diagnostic: SB vs BTN regret excess (diagnostic, as A4c)
Delta of the damped step (reported, never used for stopping)
metrics.U_k_metrics: same metric definitions, sigma_r (bootstrap replicate) in G_raw,k

stop.converged: Delta_raw,k <= U_k for every primary seat and node
stop.partial: if only some primary metrics satisfy it, report "partial pass" with the list; never call the state converged
stop.divergence: if the same primary metric Delta_raw increases at k = 1 vs 0 and again at k = 2 vs 1, stop and report (oscillation / divergence sign)
stop.budget: after k = 2 without convergence: report "not yet converged" and stop; no automatic 4th / 5th step
stop.wording: Delta_raw,k is a one-step raw residual F(x_k) - x_k measured in strategy-loss units, not the fixed-point distance; the contraction ratio Delta_raw,k / Delta_raw,k-1 is reported; any residual estimate under a contraction assumption is labelled an estimate

D1.post_outer: after E1: new file data/gto_terminal_expansion/e1/d1_post_outer.json with u_outer(h) = |EV gap_h in G_raw,K - EV gap_h in G_K| at the last evaluated step K; stable -> near_indifferent moves are expected and reported

provenance_per_step: raw and damped preflop profile + terminal export hashes
draw manifest sha256 (must equal A4c b70b1d5e...)
restart: flop artifacts are reused only when parse + provenance key (ranges hash = R_k, panel hash, menu, tree) + converged / approved status verify; incomplete outputs are quarantined; a completed step is reused only if all its recorded hashes match

cost_estimate.postflop_per_step: node 6: 232 x 0.160 CPU-h + node 28: 218 x 0.139 CPU-h = about 67 CPU-h -> about 17 h wall at 4 workers (A4c measured rates; a capped board adds up to about 1.6 h of one worker)
cost_estimate.preflop_per_step: raw + damped point solves about 2-5 min
cost_estimate.U_k_per_step: 60 preflop solves + seat swaps + node regrets, about 1-1.5 h (A4c: about 3.2 min per replicate for two panel sizes and cross swaps)
cost_estimate.max_total: 3 steps: about 200 CPU-h, about 55-57 h wall; with the 2 h background limit, about 30 resumable relaunches
cost_estimate.disk: flop artifacts about the A4c size per step (value JSON only; no strategy export)
